claims: Sinners received 16 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners set a record with 16 nominations.
Timothée Chalamet stars in Marty Supreme.
Best Picture candidates for the 98th Academy Awards are Sinners, Hamnet, Frankenstein, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, Train Dreams, One Battle After Another, Marty Supreme, Bugonia, and F1.
Elle Fanning is in Sentimental Value.
Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas is in Sentimental Value.
Teyana Taylor is in One Battle After Another.
Kate Hudson is in Song Sung Blue.
Frankenstein is available to stream on Netflix.
Train Dreams is available to stream on Netflix.
KPop Demon Hunters is available to stream on Netflix.
Sinners is available to stream on HBO Max.
Bugonia is available to stream on Peacock.
The nominees represent the top films from 2025.
